_note: One plain sentence per symptom id, for the NLI checker experiment (EXPERIMENT_GUIDE.md step 3). Drafted 2026-10-05 from the same definitions Stage B uses (DESCRIPTIONS in src/slm_classify.py), reviewed by the founder. FROZEN once scoring starts - changing any sentence after seeing scores is a separate, logged run. conscious / unconscious / not_breathing are absent on purpose: they come from the yes/no buttons, never the model. Events are in the past tense because that is how an event is described.
confused: The person is confused and not making sense.
difficulty_breathing: The person is having difficulty breathing.
face_drooping: One side of the person's face is drooping.
one_sided_weakness: The person cannot move one side of their body.
severe_abdominal_pain: The person has severe stomach pain.
high_fever: The person has a high fever.
cold_sweat: The person is in a cold sweat.
lower_back_pain: The person has lower back pain.
numbness: Part of the person's body is numb.
body_cold: The person's body is cold to the touch.
fall: The person fell over on flat ground.
fall_down: The person fell down stairs or a slope.
seizure: The person is having a seizure.
head_injury: The person has a head injury.
